scope: language_model only; vision, embedding and lm_head frozen
checkpoint_selection: final step30, preselected; test never used for selection

evaluation.primary: semantic final-answer correctness out of20; human scored with reference key
evaluation.failure_policy: retain all attempts; token-limit and malformed/empty finals are failures; infrastructure failures are recorded separately and only rerun unchanged
evaluation.sampling_note: one seeded sample per case is preliminary evidence; no seed search or retries for wrong answers
